brief:
Israel has pledged to continue its "offensive policy" in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English, even as the country operates under a caretaker government. The commitment comes amid broader regional tensions fueled by fighting in Yemen.

Israel intends to sustain military operations in Gaza regardless of the constraints typically imposed by a caretaker administration, which normally limits major policy decisions pending elections or government formation.
dek: Saudi-led coalition strikes down three Houthi drones in as many hours, as Bahrain issues potential danger alert.
title: Israel vows to press Gaza offensive despite caretaker government status
